summary: Retest of reported bug '/admin is completely unresponsive'. Result: BUG NOT REPRODUCED. Every interactive element on SuperAdminDashboard is fully clickable and the DOM responds correctly. Backend 8/8 pytest (test_super_admin.py) pass. Frontend Playwright flow verified: super_admin login (qayum@smrtin.net/Apple@786) redirects to /admin; sa-tab-users/buildings/activity each reveal their respective sa-users-table / sa-buildings-table / sa-activity content on click; document.elementFromPoint at Buildings-tab center returns the tab BUTTON itself (data-testid=sa-tab-buildings) — no invisible overlay is trapping clicks; sidebar nav-global-activity navigates to /admin/activity, nav-super-admin returns to /admin; logout-button clears session and returns to /login. URL is stable at /admin 3s after login (no render storm / redirect loop) and keyboard Tab press is responsive (main thread not locked). Building admin (admin@fastvi.com) correctly lands on /building-admin (not /admin) and is interactive. 0 console errors captured across the entire flow. Stat cards populate with real numbers (Users=7, etc.).
critical_code_review_comments: SuperAdminDashboard.js useEffect has empty deps and only fires once — correct; no re-render storm risk.
GlobalWs floating indicator uses pointer-events-none + z-10; verified via elementFromPoint that it does not intercept clicks on tabs at (cx,cy).
ProtectedRoute fallback map (super_admin->/admin, admin->/building-admin, ...) is non-recursive and works as expected — building admin hitting /admin is bounced to /building-admin cleanly.
server.py is now ~800+ lines with platform endpoints added; consider splitting into routers before it grows further.
test_credentials: super_admin qayum@smrtin.net/Apple@786 verified; admin@fastvi.com/admin123 verified; both return correct role and access_token.
seed_data_creation: None new. Super admin is upserted by backend startup seed logic.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bug 'admin screen unresponsive' could not be reproduced on the deployed preview URL. If user still sees it, ask for (1) browser console screenshot, (2) exact URL after login, (3) whether service worker/CDN cache might be serving old JS — a hard reload may be needed on the client. All data-testids on SuperAdminDashboard: sa-tabs, sa-tab-users, sa-tab-buildings, sa-tab-activity, sa-users-table, sa-buildings-table, sa-activity, sa-stat-users/buildings/units/guards/passes/calls/online/weekly/admins.
rca of the issue: No production defect found in current build. Possible original cause was stale AuthContext object identity causing GlobalWs useEffect to reconnect indefinitely, or a full-screen element without pointer-events-none. Both are already fixed in the tree: AuthContext value is memoized (useMemo + useCallback) and GlobalWs pill has pointer-events-none plus a MAX_WS_ATTEMPTS=5 cap. elementFromPoint check confirms no overlay is currently trapping clicks.
